faqs.a:
The council, on behalf of the city and in its name, for the purpose of defraying all
               the cost of acquiring or improving, or acquiring and improving, any project herein
               authorized, or any portion of the cost thereof not to be defrayed with moneys available
               therefor from the general fund, any special fund or otherwise, shall have power hereunder
               to:
(1)
Levy assessments against assessable property within the city and to cause the assessments
                  so levied to be collected;
(2)
Pledge the proceeds of any assessments levied hereunder to the payment of special
                  assessment bonds and to create liens on such proceeds to secure such payments;
(3)
Issue special assessment bonds as herein provided; and
(4)
Make all contracts, to execute all instruments and to do all things necessary or convenient
                  in the exercise of the powers granted herein or in the performance of the city's duties
                  or in order to secure the payment of its bonds; provided, however, no encumbrance,
                  mortgage or other pledge of property (excluding any money) of the city is created
                  thereby; and provided no property (excluding any money) of the city is liable to be
                  forfeited or to be taken in payment of the bonds.
(Code 1981, § 27-8; Ord. No. 551, § 6, 5-14-1964)
